expected_sentence_mappings.text: In October 2023, security analysts identified a targeted intrusion campaign targeting industrial manufacturing firms.
expected_sentence_mappings.reason: Background context without specific adversary TTP.

expected_sentence_mappings.text: The threat actor initially gained access through spearphishing emails containing a password-protected ZIP archive.
Upon opening the lure document, an embedded macro executed a hidden PowerShell script to bypass execution policy restrictions.
The malicious PowerShell command downloaded a secondary payload from an external command and control server.
To maintain persistence on the compromised host, the adversary created a scheduled task named 'SystemUpdate' configured to run hourly.
The intrusion operators subsequently dumped credentials from the Local Security Authority Subsystem Service (LSASS) process memory.
Following credential acquisition, the attacker conducted internal reconnaissance using native Windows utilities such as whoami and net user.
The adversary moved laterally across the corporate network by initiating Remote Desktop Protocol sessions using stolen administrative credentials.
Before completing their objectives, the operators cleared the Windows security event logs using wevtutil to impede forensic investigations.
expected_sentence_mappings.technique_name: Indicator Removal: Clear Windows Event Logs

expected_sentence_mappings.text: Stolen proprietary design files were compressed into password-protected RAR archives prior to staging.
expected_sentence_mappings.technique_name: Archive Collected Data: Archive via Utility

expected_sentence_mappings.text: The staged archives were exfiltrated over an encrypted HTTPS connection to an adversary-controlled server located overseas.
Incident response teams isolated the affected workstations and deployed endpoint detection rules to mitigate future intrusions.
expected_sentence_mappings.reason: Defensive incident response action, not adversary behavior.

expected_sentence_mappings.text: Organizations are advised to enforce multi-factor authentication across all external remote access services.
